primary.numerator: served service units whose independent correctness criterion fails or whose assurance was applied while calibration was invalid
primary.denominator: all service units for which continuation was unsafe under the frozen oracle/validity label
primary.aggregation: policy-specific pooled estimate plus window-level distribution
primary.uncertainty: Wilson 95% CI; hierarchical/bootstrap sensitivity if pilot supports it

primary.numerator: held or blocked units that were supported and independently correct
attempted recoveries returning a result that passes the independent service criterion
primary.aggregation: strategy, policy, context class, and window

primary.numerator: fallback results passing the exact/reference criterion
elapsed monotonic time from initial hold/invalid decision to verified recovered result
primary.aggregation: median and empirical survival curve by strategy

primary.numerator: requests returning a criterion-valid result inside the service deadline
predeclared held-out OOS units abstained before calibrated assurance
primary.uncertainty: Wilson 95% CI; AUROC bootstrap only for continuous score

primary.numerator: eligible units exceeding the frozen error event while nominal calibration was asserted
primary.denominator: units on which a nominal calibrated assertion was made
primary.experimental_unit: test unit declared in calibration specification
primary.uncertainty: Wilson 95% CI; compare with alpha only under frozen premises

secondary.denominator: jobs for which provider exposes timestamps

secondary.aggregation: bytes and percentage of raw artifact size
